name: SupplierAllotmentManager
tagline: Sell your allotments, release the rest on time.
description: A complete allotment app for tour operators and DMCs: hotel rooms, airline seats, coach seats and cruise cabins per date with utilisation, release dates and warnings, stop-sales, an inventory calendar, a release planner and contract rates – for Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Utilisation, free units and release date per line
Release overdue / at risk / releasing soon / overbooked / high demand flags
Stop-sale and re-open with mandatory reason
Release unsold units with one click or in bulk
Multi-currency net rates with FX conversion
